card_lines: TOP: use your 3 Emperor attempts on Autistocat and push past showdown 73. Pulse: stand on the small platform next to the boss and auto attack so the skulls bounce; Skull + Aura only, 2nd-page damage talents, boost foods. Big pushes are best saved for statue week.
Coming up: showdown 74: 0.3x Ninja Stealth, showdown 75: 0.05x Deathbringer Extra Bones, showdown 76: +1 Opals, showdown 77: +15% Equinox Bar Fill Rate.
